policy.zh: 本文件定义 KMD Owner 与子方向的稳定职责、边界和长期演进含义。默认不随单期 Industry Updates、feature priority 或资料更新而变化；只有在明确调整 taxonomy、职责边界或长期方向时才修改。
policy.en: This file defines the stable responsibilities, boundaries, and long-term meaning of KMD Owners and sub-directions. It must not change with routine Industry Updates, feature priorities, or resource refreshes; update it only when taxonomy, ownership boundaries, or long-term direction is explicitly revised.

memory.description_zh: 负责 GPU 地址空间与页表、Linux MM/HMM/SVM 集成、GPU fault、CPU↔GPU page migration、oversubscription、IOMMU/SVA 以及最终 multi-GPU/heterogeneous memory 的完整内存架构。这个 Owner 的核心不是某个单独分配接口，而是建立 CPU VA、GPU VA、物理 residency、DMA mapping、GPU PTE、TLB 和 fault/replay 之间一致且可扩展的生命周期模型。随着系统演进，它从 GPUVM correctness 逐步扩展到 unified memory policy、large/compound page、NUMA/tiered memory 与 multi-GPU UVM。
memory.description_en: Own the complete GPU memory architecture spanning GPU address spaces/page tables, Linux MM/HMM/SVM integration, GPU faults, CPU↔GPU migration, oversubscription, IOMMU/SVA, and eventually multi-GPU/heterogeneous memory. The core responsibility is not a single allocation API but a coherent lifetime model across CPU VA, GPU VA, physical residency, DMA mappings, GPU PTEs, TLBs, and fault/replay. It evolves from GPUVM correctness toward unified-memory policy, large/compound pages, NUMA/tiered memory, and multi-GPU UVM.
memory.boundary_zh: Memory Owner 管 page/VA/residency/migration policy；Multi-GPU Owner 管 device/topology/peer transport；Virtualization Owner 管 tenant/resource isolation。
memory.boundary_en: Memory owns page/VA/residency/migration policy; Multi-GPU owns device/topology/peer transport; Virtualization owns tenant/resource isolation.

subdirections.title: GPUVM / Page Tables / VMID / PASID / TLB
subdirections.short_zh: GPU 虚拟地址空间与硬件页表的基础层。
subdirections.short_en: Foundation for GPU virtual address spaces and hardware page tables.
subdirections.detail_zh: 负责 VA range 管理、page-table hierarchy、PTE format/update ordering、VMID/PASID 绑定、TLB invalidation、sparse/large-page 映射以及 VM lifetime。它决定后续 fault、migration、userptr/HMM 和 multi-GPU shared-VA 是否有稳定承载层。
subdirections.detail_en: Own VA-range management, page-table hierarchy, PTE formats/update ordering, VMID/PASID binding, TLB invalidation, sparse/large-page mappings, and VM lifetime. This is the substrate for faults, migration, userptr/HMM, and future shared VA.

subdirections.title: Recoverable GPU Page Fault / Fault Replay
subdirections.short_zh: 把 GPU page fault 从 fatal error 变成可恢复内存服务。
subdirections.short_en: Turn GPU page faults from fatal errors into a recoverable memory service.
subdirections.detail_zh: 负责 fault packet 分类、PASID/VM/context 解析、CPU PTE/HMM 状态获取、residency/migration 决策、GPU PTE 修复、TLB invalidate 和 replay/terminate。必须显式处理 munmap/mprotect/COW/process exit/VM teardown/GPU reset 等竞态。
subdirections.detail_en: Own fault classification, PASID/VM/context resolution, CPU-PTE/HMM state inspection, residency/migration decisions, GPU-PTE repair, TLB invalidation, and replay/termination, including teardown and reset races.

subdirections.title: mmu_notifier / HMM / SVM / Device-private Memory
subdirections.short_zh: 连接 Linux CPU 页表与 GPU memory view。
subdirections.short_en: Bridge Linux CPU page tables and GPU memory views.
subdirections.detail_zh: 负责 mmu_notifier/mmu_interval_notifier ordering、HMM range snapshot、shared VA、userptr、device-private page 和 CPU/GPU 双向 ownership 协调。关键是 CPU MM invalidation 与 KMD VM/context generation 不能互相替代。
subdirections.detail_en: Own notifier ordering, HMM snapshots, shared VA, userptr, device-private pages, and CPU/GPU ownership coordination. CPU-MM invalidation and KMD VM/context generations solve different lifetime problems.

subdirections.title: CPU↔GPU Migration / Oversubscription / Eviction
subdirections.short_zh: 建立 page residency 变化与显存压力闭环。
subdirections.short_en: Build the residency-change and VRAM-pressure loop.
subdirections.detail_zh: 负责 system→VRAM、VRAM→system migration、copy/DMA/PTE/TLB ordering、eviction、oversubscription、working-set/hotness signal 与 failure rollback。机制层应与 policy 层解耦。
subdirections.detail_en: Own system↔VRAM migration, copy/DMA/PTE/TLB ordering, eviction, oversubscription, working-set/hotness signals, and rollback. Keep migration mechanics separate from policy.

subdirections.title: NUMA / Large & Compound Pages / Migration Granularity
subdirections.short_zh: 让内存模型从固定 4K 演进到更大、更异构的单位。
subdirections.short_en: Evolve beyond fixed 4K assumptions toward larger and heterogeneous units.
subdirections.detail_zh: 明确 CPU base page、fault range、migration unit、DMA mapping unit、GPU PTE unit、TLB unit 可以不同；研究 64K/2M/compound device pages、higher-order DMA、NUMA placement 与 tiered-memory policy。
subdirections.detail_en: Treat CPU base pages, fault ranges, migration units, DMA mapping units, GPU PTE units, and TLB units as separable; cover 64K/2M/compound pages, higher-order DMA, NUMA placement, and tiered memory.

subdirections.title: IOMMU / ATS / PRI / PASID / SVA
subdirections.short_zh: 把 GPU 地址翻译和 Linux IOMMU/SVA 能力连接起来。
subdirections.short_en: Connect GPU address translation with Linux IOMMU/SVA capabilities.
subdirections.detail_zh: 负责 device DMA addressability、IOMMU mapping、PASID namespace、ATS translation cache、PRI page request 与 SVA/process address-space sharing。重点是明确 GPU MMU 与 IOMMU 各自的翻译、缓存和 invalidation 边界。
subdirections.detail_en: Own DMA addressability, IOMMU mappings, PASID namespaces, ATS, PRI, and SVA/process address-space sharing, with clear boundaries between GPU-MMU and IOMMU translation/invalidation.

subdirections.title: dma-buf / P2P Memory
subdirections.short_zh: 处理跨设备 buffer ownership、sharing 与 peer memory 访问。
subdirections.short_en: Handle cross-device buffer ownership, sharing, and peer-memory access.
subdirections.detail_zh: 负责 dma-buf attach/map lifecycle、scatter-gather、implicit/explicit synchronization、peer memory export/import、P2P DMA 可达性以及与 GPUVM/residency 的衔接。
subdirections.detail_en: Own dma-buf attach/map lifetimes, scatter-gather mappings, synchronization, peer-memory export/import, P2P-DMA reachability, and integration with GPUVM/residency.

subdirections.title: Multi-GPU Unified Memory
subdirections.short_zh: 在多个 GPU 上扩展 shared VA、residency 与 migration。
subdirections.short_en: Extend shared VA, residency, and migration across multiple GPUs.
subdirections.detail_zh: 建立一个 CPU VA/range 对多个 per-device residency/DMA/PTE state 的 N:1 数据模型，支持 peer mapping、shared VM、跨 GPU migration/replication 与 policy。它建立在 Memory 与 Multi-GPU 两条线都成熟之后。
subdirections.detail_en: Build an N:1 model where one CPU VA/range maps to per-device residency/DMA/PTE state, enabling peer mappings, shared VM, migration/replication, and policy after both Memory and Multi-GPU foundations mature.

virt.description_zh: 负责 GPU 在 VM、容器和多租户场景下的 ownership、resource partition、reset/isolation 与 security boundary。它关注的不是 generic VFIO 或 pci_enable_sriov() API 本身，而是如何把 VMID、queue、doorbell、interrupt、memory aperture、engine 和 firmware service 安全地划分给不同 tenant，并保证 reset、error 和 accounting 不跨越隔离边界。
virt.description_en: Own GPU ownership, resource partitioning, reset/isolation, and security boundaries for VMs, containers, and multi-tenant use. The focus is not generic VFIO or pci_enable_sriov() itself, but safe partitioning of VMIDs, queues, doorbells, interrupts, memory apertures, engines, and firmware services with tenant-safe reset, error, and accounting semantics.
virt.boundary_zh: Virtualization/Security 管 tenant isolation 与 ownership；Firmware Owner 提供底层稳定 resource/control service；Memory Owner 管页级 residency/migration。
virt.boundary_en: Virtualization/Security owns tenant isolation and ownership; Firmware provides stable lower control/resource services; Memory owns page-level residency/migration.

subdirections.title: VFIO Passthrough / Ownership / IOMMU Isolation
subdirections.short_zh: 建立安全的整设备直通与 ownership 切换。
subdirections.short_en: Establish safe whole-device passthrough and ownership transfer.
subdirections.detail_zh: 覆盖 IOMMU group、device binding/unbinding、DMA isolation、IRQ/BAR exposure、reset semantics 和 host↔guest ownership transfer。它是虚拟化基础能力，但不是长期 Owner 的全部价值。
subdirections.detail_en: Cover IOMMU groups, device binding, DMA isolation, IRQ/BAR exposure, reset semantics, and host↔guest ownership transfer. It is a foundation, not the whole virtualization domain.

subdirections.title: SR-IOV PF/VF Lifecycle
subdirections.short_zh: 管理 PF/VF 创建、销毁和 driver lifecycle。
subdirections.short_en: Manage PF/VF creation, destruction, and driver lifecycle.
subdirections.detail_zh: 负责 PF mode、VF count/probe ordering、VF enable/disable、resource provisioning、PF↔VF discovery 以及配置生命周期。只有 ASIC 真实支持 SR-IOV 时才进入主动开发。
subdirections.detail_en: Own PF mode, VF counts/probe ordering, VF enable/disable, resource provisioning, PF↔VF discovery, and configuration lifecycle, gated by real ASIC support.

subdirections.title: GPU Resource Partition / VMID / Queue / Doorbell / Memory
subdirections.short_zh: 把 GPU-specific 资源切成可隔离 tenant slice。
subdirections.short_en: Partition GPU-specific resources into isolated tenant slices.
subdirections.detail_zh: 定义 VMID/context/queue/doorbell/interrupt/engine/VRAM aperture 等资源的分配、quota、ownership 与回收，是 SR-IOV/vGPU 真正区别于 generic PCI virtualization 的核心。
subdirections.detail_en: Define allocation, quotas, ownership, and reclamation for VMIDs, contexts, queues, doorbells, interrupts, engines, and VRAM apertures—the GPU-specific core beyond generic PCI virtualization.

subdirections.title: PF↔VF ABI / VF FLR / Reset / Accounting
subdirections.short_zh: 建立 tenant-safe 控制、恢复和计量边界。
subdirections.short_en: Build tenant-safe control, recovery, and accounting boundaries.
subdirections.detail_zh: 负责 PF↔VF command/event ABI、VF FLR、per-VF reset、fault containment、resource accounting 与 abuse protection，确保一个 VF 的 crash/reset 不破坏其他 tenant。
subdirections.detail_en: Own PF↔VF ABI, VF FLR/per-VF reset, fault containment, resource accounting, and abuse protection so one tenant cannot corrupt others.

subdirections.title: vGPU / Live Migration Groundwork
subdirections.short_zh: 为 mediated/vGPU 与跨主机状态迁移准备可序列化状态模型。
subdirections.short_en: Prepare serializable state models for mediated/vGPU and migration.
subdirections.detail_zh: 梳理 guest-visible state、device state save/restore、dirty tracking、compatibility/versioning 与 migration stop/resume boundary；这是更后期、依赖 control/resource model 成熟的方向。
subdirections.detail_en: Model guest-visible state, device save/restore, dirty tracking, compatibility/versioning, and migration stop/resume boundaries; a later-stage direction built on mature control/resource models.

subdirections.title: Secure Boot / Measurement / Scrub / Attestation
subdirections.short_zh: 把 GPU 从“能隔离”提升到“可证明、可清理、可可信启动”。
subdirections.short_en: Move from isolation to measurable, scrubbed, attestable trust.
subdirections.detail_zh: 覆盖 firmware authenticity/measurement、VRAM/register/context scrub、tenant data remanence、attestation、secure reset 和 confidential-compute 相关边界。
subdirections.detail_en: Cover firmware authenticity/measurement, VRAM/register/context scrubbing, tenant data remanence, attestation, secure reset, and confidential-compute boundaries.

power.description_zh: 负责 GPU 从可测量 utilization 到 DVFS、runtime PM、thermal/power cap 的完整能效控制链。核心原则是 measurement、policy、actuation 与 lifetime correctness 分层：先能可靠回答 GPU/engine 是否 busy、频率驻留和 bandwidth，再将这些信号用于 DVFS/runtime PM；复杂 workload-aware governor 应建立在稳定 telemetry 与 firmware/hardware control contract 之后。
power.description_en: Own the energy-efficiency chain from measurable utilization through DVFS, runtime PM, thermal control, and power caps. Keep measurement, policy, actuation, and lifetime correctness separated: first measure GPU/engine busy state, frequency residency, and bandwidth; then feed stable telemetry into DVFS/runtime PM, with complex workload-aware policy only after control contracts mature.
power.boundary_zh: Power Owner 管 measurement/policy/lifetime；Firmware Owner 管底层 FW PM service/actuation contract；Observability Owner 可复用 telemetry 做 profiling。
power.boundary_en: Power owns measurement/policy/lifetime; Firmware owns low-level FW PM service/actuation contracts; Observability may reuse telemetry for profiling.

subdirections.title: Busy/Idle / Per-engine Utilization
subdirections.short_zh: 建立可复用的 GPU activity 计量层。
subdirections.short_en: Build a reusable GPU activity measurement layer.
subdirections.detail_zh: 定义 busy/idle 语义、per-engine active time、sampling window、context attribution 与 counter wrap/reset，避免 utilization 只服务某一个 governor。
subdirections.detail_en: Define busy/idle semantics, per-engine active time, sampling windows, context attribution, and counter reset/wrap behavior so utilization is reusable.

subdirections.title: Runtime PM / Suspend-Resume / PCI D-states
subdirections.short_zh: 管理设备 active reference 与低功耗状态生命周期。
subdirections.short_en: Manage active references and device low-power lifetimes.
subdirections.detail_zh: 负责 runtime suspend/resume、system suspend、PCI D-state、VRAM/firmware/queue dependency、active reference ownership 和 resume state restoration。难点通常是资源顺序而不是单纯关时钟。
subdirections.detail_en: Own runtime/system suspend, PCI D-states, VRAM/firmware/queue dependencies, active-reference ownership, and state restoration; resource ordering is the hard part.

subdirections.title: Clock / Power Gating / Idle Residency
subdirections.short_zh: 控制局部硬件进入/退出 idle 与断电状态。
subdirections.short_en: Control block-level idle, clock-gated, and power-gated states.
subdirections.detail_zh: 定义 idle detect、clock gating、power island、retention、wake latency 与 block dependency；需要与 runtime PM 和 firmware control 协调。
subdirections.detail_en: Define idle detection, clock gating, power islands, retention, wake latency, and block dependencies coordinated with runtime PM and firmware.

subdirections.title: DVFS / OPP / Firmware PM Protocol
subdirections.short_zh: 把 utilization/constraint 转换为频率与电压控制。
subdirections.short_en: Translate utilization and constraints into frequency/voltage control.
subdirections.detail_zh: 负责 OPP/frequency domain、min/max constraint、boost、firmware-managed PM protocol、transition latency 与 policy/actuation 分层。
subdirections.detail_en: Own OPP/frequency domains, min/max constraints, boost, firmware-managed PM protocols, transition latency, and policy/actuation separation.

subdirections.title: Thermal Throttling / Power Cap
subdirections.short_zh: 处理热约束、功率预算和系统级限频。
subdirections.short_en: Handle thermal constraints, power budgets, and system-level throttling.
subdirections.detail_zh: 负责 temperature sensor、thermal trip、power cap、throttle reason、platform budget 与 CPU/GPU shared thermal envelope 协调。
subdirections.detail_en: Own temperature sensors, thermal trips, power caps, throttle reasons, platform budgets, and shared CPU/GPU thermal envelopes.

subdirections.title: Frequency Residency / Memory-bandwidth Telemetry
subdirections.short_zh: 建立 PM 与 profiling 共用的稳定计量接口。
subdirections.short_en: Build stable telemetry shared by PM and profiling.
subdirections.detail_zh: 输出 frequency residency、memory bandwidth、stall/idle distribution、engine activity 等长期可解释指标，并定义 sampling/discovery/versioning。
subdirections.detail_en: Expose frequency residency, memory bandwidth, stall/idle distributions, and engine activity with stable sampling/discovery/versioning semantics.

ras.description_zh: 负责 GPU 故障从 detect、diagnose、contain 到 recover 的完整闭环，并最终形成生产级 RAS。核心价值不是 printk + full reset，而是在 destructive recovery 前冻结可离线分析的 crash evidence，建立 job/queue/context/engine/GPU 分级恢复，并把 firmware、MMU/page-fault、ECC/AER 等不同错误域统一进可追踪的故障生命周期。
ras.description_en: Own the full GPU fault lifecycle from detection and diagnosis through containment and recovery, ultimately forming production-grade RAS. The goal is not printk + full reset, but preserving analyzable crash evidence before destructive recovery, building graded job/queue/context/engine/GPU recovery, and unifying firmware, MMU/page-fault, ECC/AER error domains.
ras.boundary_zh: RAS Owner 管 failure semantics、evidence 与 recovery policy；Observability 提供平时 trace/PMU；Firmware 提供 FW health/log/restart mechanism。
ras.boundary_en: RAS owns failure semantics, evidence, and recovery policy; Observability provides continuous trace/PMU; Firmware provides FW health/log/restart mechanisms.

subdirections.title: Heartbeat / Watchdog / Hang Detection
subdirections.short_zh: 可靠判断 GPU/FW 是否停止前进。
subdirections.short_en: Reliably detect loss of GPU/FW forward progress.
subdirections.detail_zh: 定义 heartbeat/progress source、timeout、false-positive suppression、job/queue/engine/FW hang classification 和 escalation trigger。
subdirections.detail_en: Define heartbeat/progress sources, timeouts, false-positive suppression, hang classification, and escalation triggers.

subdirections.title: Hang Snapshot / devcoredump / Reset Reason
subdirections.short_zh: 在 reset 前冻结唯一有效的故障证据。
subdirections.short_en: Freeze the only valid failure evidence before reset.
subdirections.detail_zh: 建立 versioned crash object，包含 register/ring/queue/context/VM/fault/FW log/reset generation 等 section，并通过 devcoredump 或等价接口延迟交给 userspace。
subdirections.detail_en: Build versioned crash objects with register/ring/queue/context/VM/fault/FW-log/reset-generation sections and expose them to userspace after capture.

subdirections.title: Job Abort / Queue Kill / Context Kill / Engine Reset
subdirections.short_zh: 从最小影响范围开始做分级恢复。
subdirections.short_en: Recover at the smallest viable scope first.
subdirections.detail_zh: 定义 job abort、queue/context kill、engine reset、partial/full reset 的触发条件、资源回收、上层通知和 fallback ladder。
subdirections.detail_en: Define triggers, cleanup, upper-layer notification, and fallback ladders across job abort, queue/context kill, engine reset, and wider resets.

subdirections.title: Post-reset Restore / Replay
subdirections.short_zh: 决定 reset 后哪些状态可恢复、哪些 workload 必须失败。
subdirections.short_en: Decide what state can be restored after reset and what work must fail.
subdirections.detail_zh: 负责 VM/context/queue/FW state reconstruction、generation invalidation、pending job/replay legality 与 userspace error semantics。
subdirections.detail_en: Own VM/context/queue/FW reconstruction, generation invalidation, pending-job/replay legality, and userspace error semantics.

subdirections.title: Firmware Crash Recovery / FW Log Retention
subdirections.short_zh: 把 FW failure 纳入同一 GPU recovery architecture。
subdirections.short_en: Integrate firmware failures into the same GPU recovery architecture.
subdirections.detail_zh: 负责 FW heartbeat、panic/log buffer、probe/boot failure evidence、restart generation、re-handshake 与 KMD/FW state reconciliation。
subdirections.detail_en: Own FW heartbeat, panic/log buffers, boot/probe-failure evidence, restart generations, re-handshake, and state reconciliation.

subdirections.title: ECC / Bad-page Retirement / PCIe AER / Fault Injection
subdirections.short_zh: 处理硬件可靠性、坏页与总线错误。
subdirections.short_en: Handle hardware reliability, bad pages, and bus errors.
subdirections.detail_zh: 覆盖 CE/UE accounting、bad-page retirement、poison handling、PCIe AER、fault injection、persistent error counters 与 serviceability policy。
subdirections.detail_en: Cover CE/UE accounting, bad-page retirement, poison handling, PCIe AER, fault injection, persistent counters, and serviceability policy.

multi.description_zh: 负责多个 GPU 作为一个系统时的 device model、stable identity、visibility/affinity、PCIe/NUMA/switch topology、P2P transport 与 fabric health。这个 Owner 先回答“有哪些 GPU、彼此如何连接、谁能看到谁、能否 peer access、链路状态如何”，再为 shared VM、collective runtime 和跨 GPU memory policy 提供基础信息；page residency/migration 本身仍归 Memory。
multi.description_en: Own the multi-device model, stable identity, visibility/affinity, PCIe/NUMA/switch topology, P2P transport, and fabric health. First answer which GPUs exist, how they connect, who can see whom, whether peer access is possible, and link health; then provide foundations for shared VM, runtimes, and memory policy while page residency/migration remains with Memory.
multi.boundary_zh: Multi-GPU 管 identity/topology/connectivity/transport；Memory 管 shared-VA residency/migration；collective algorithm policy 通常在 NCCL/UMD/runtime。
multi.boundary_en: Multi-GPU owns identity/topology/connectivity/transport; Memory owns shared-VA residency/migration; collective algorithms usually live in NCCL/UMD/runtime.

subdirections.title: Multi-GPU Enumeration / Stable Identity
subdirections.short_zh: 建立不会随 probe 顺序漂移的 GPU 身份模型。
subdirections.short_en: Build GPU identities that do not drift with probe order.
subdirections.detail_zh: 统一 physical/logical GPU ID、BDF、DRM minor、firmware ID、NUMA node 和 user-visible index，保证日志、topology、P2P、RAS 都能复用同一 identity。
subdirections.detail_en: Unify physical/logical IDs, BDFs, DRM minors, firmware IDs, NUMA nodes, and user-visible indices for reuse across topology, P2P, logs, and RAS.

subdirections.title: Device Visibility / Affinity / Namespace / Cgroup
subdirections.short_zh: 控制进程/容器看到和优先使用哪些 GPU。
subdirections.short_en: Control which GPUs a process/container sees and prefers.
subdirections.detail_zh: 负责 allowed GPU set、visibility namespace、affinity/hint、container/cgroup integration 与 locality-aware placement 的基础接口。
subdirections.detail_en: Own allowed-GPU sets, visibility namespaces, affinity hints, container/cgroup integration, and locality-aware placement primitives.

subdirections.title: PCIe / NUMA / Switch Topology
subdirections.short_zh: 建立 GPU 间距离、共享 root/switch 与 CPU locality 模型。
subdirections.short_en: Model inter-GPU distance, shared roots/switches, and CPU locality.
subdirections.detail_zh: 枚举 PCIe root/switch、NUMA node、link width/speed、hop/distance matrix，并暴露给 P2P capability 和上层 runtime。
subdirections.detail_en: Enumerate PCIe roots/switches, NUMA nodes, link width/speed, hop/distance matrices, and expose them to P2P capability and runtimes.

subdirections.title: P2P Capability / Peer BAR / Peer PTE
subdirections.short_zh: 判断并建立 GPU 对 peer memory 的地址可达性。
subdirections.short_en: Determine and establish peer-memory addressability.
subdirections.detail_zh: 负责 peer capability query、BAR/aperture、peer PTE、IOMMU/ACS/topology restrictions 与 enable/disable lifecycle。
subdirections.detail_en: Own peer capability queries, BAR/aperture access, peer PTEs, IOMMU/ACS/topology restrictions, and enable/disable lifecycle.

subdirections.title: P2P DMA / Cross-GPU dma-buf
subdirections.short_zh: 完成实际跨 GPU 数据传输与 buffer sharing。
subdirections.short_en: Implement actual cross-GPU data transfer and buffer sharing.
subdirections.detail_zh: 覆盖 P2P DMA path、dma-buf cross-device map、synchronization、fallback via system memory、error handling 与 bandwidth/latency measurement。
subdirections.detail_en: Cover P2P-DMA paths, cross-device dma-buf mappings, synchronization, system-memory fallback, errors, and bandwidth/latency measurement.

subdirections.title: Shared VA / Multi-GPU VM / Fabric Health
subdirections.short_zh: 把多个 GPU 从 peer copy 推进到 shared address-space/fabric system。
subdirections.short_en: Move from peer copy toward shared address-space and fabric systems.
subdirections.detail_zh: 负责 multi-device VM metadata、common VA/peer mapping prerequisite、fabric link health/reset/ordering observability，并作为 Memory multi-GPU UVM 的底层 device/fabric service。
subdirections.detail_en: Own multi-device VM metadata, common-VA prerequisites, fabric link health/reset/ordering observability, and lower device/fabric services for Memory-side multi-GPU UVM.

obs.description_zh: 负责把 GPU 软件事件、KMD/FW 生命周期、硬件 PMU counter 和用户 workload 统一到可关联的 object/timestamp 模型中，服务 bring-up、性能分析、故障定位和后续 programmable diagnostics。核心不是“使用 eBPF”本身，而是稳定定义 device→PID/PASID→VM→context→queue→job→fault/migration/reset 的 identity 和事件语义，让 trace、PMU、crash snapshot、FW log 都能互相 join。
obs.description_en: Own a correlatable object/timestamp model across GPU software events, KMD/FW lifetimes, hardware PMU counters, and user workloads for bring-up, performance analysis, failure diagnosis, and programmable diagnostics. The core is not eBPF itself but stable identity/event semantics from device→PID/PASID→VM→context→queue→job→fault/migration/reset so trace, PMU, crash snapshots, and FW logs can join.
obs.boundary_zh: Observability 管持续观测模型与工具；RAS 管 failure artifact/recovery；Power 可提供/消费 telemetry；programmable policy 只有在 safety/ABI 成熟后才进入产品化。
obs.boundary_en: Observability owns continuous measurement models/tools; RAS owns failure artifacts/recovery; Power shares telemetry; programmable policy remains non-product until safety/ABI mature.

subdirections.title: Stable KMD Tracepoint / Event Model
subdirections.short_zh: 先定义长期稳定的软件事件语义。
subdirections.short_en: Define durable software-event semantics first.
subdirections.detail_zh: 为 VM/context/queue/job/fault/migration/FW/reset 等 lifetime edge 定义稳定 tracepoint、字段、版本与 object ID，避免 debug script 各自造 schema。
subdirections.detail_en: Define stable tracepoints, fields, versions, and object IDs for VM/context/queue/job/fault/migration/FW/reset lifetime edges.

subdirections.title: BTF / CO-RE / eBPF Dynamic Tracing
subdirections.short_zh: 在稳定事件之外提供低侵入动态观测能力。
subdirections.short_en: Provide low-intrusion dynamic observability beyond static events.
subdirections.detail_zh: 使用 fentry/fexit/kprobe/tracepoint、BTF/CO-RE 构建跨 kernel version 的动态调试与临时指标，不把私有结构直接固化成用户 ABI。
subdirections.detail_en: Use fentry/fexit/kprobes/tracepoints with BTF/CO-RE for dynamic debugging and temporary metrics without freezing private structures as uAPI.

subdirections.title: PID / PASID / VM / Context / Queue / Job Correlation
subdirections.short_zh: 建立跨层统一对象身份。
subdirections.short_en: Build unified cross-layer object identity.
subdirections.detail_zh: 明确 PID/client/PASID/VM/context/queue/job/fault/migration/FW seq/reset generation 的映射和 lifetime，使不同数据源能够 join。
subdirections.detail_en: Define mappings and lifetimes among PID/client/PASID/VM/context/queue/job/fault/migration/FW-seq/reset-generation so sources can be joined.

subdirections.title: UMD→KMD→FW→GPU Unified Timeline
subdirections.short_zh: 把软件提交、FW 处理和 GPU 执行放进同一时间轴。
subdirections.short_en: Place userspace submission, firmware processing, and GPU execution on one timeline.
subdirections.detail_zh: 解决 clock domain、timestamp normalization、sequence correlation 与 event causality，使性能和故障定位可以从 API 调用一路追到 GPU hardware。
subdirections.detail_en: Solve clock domains, timestamp normalization, sequence correlation, and causality from API calls through firmware to GPU hardware.

subdirections.title: GPU PMU / Counter Discovery / Sampling / Multiplexing
subdirections.short_zh: 建立标准化硬件性能计数器层。
subdirections.short_en: Build a standardized hardware-performance-counter layer.
subdirections.detail_zh: 负责 counter discovery/name/encoding、sampling、multiplexing、overflow、per-context attribution 与 PMU reset/versioning，并与软件 timeline 关联。
subdirections.detail_en: Own counter discovery/naming/encoding, sampling, multiplexing, overflow, per-context attribution, reset/versioning, and correlation with software timelines.

subdirections.title: perf_event / Dynamic Diagnostics / Programmable Hooks
subdirections.short_zh: 把稳定观测能力接入标准 tooling，并探索受控可编程诊断。
subdirections.short_en: Integrate stable observability with standard tooling and explore controlled programmable diagnostics.
subdirections.detail_zh: 评估 perf_event 集成、dynamic diagnostics、verified eBPF hook 和实验性 policy interface；当前优先 observability，programmable scheduling/memory policy 作为长期研究方向。
subdirections.detail_en: Evaluate perf_event integration, dynamic diagnostics, verified eBPF hooks, and experimental policy interfaces; prioritize observability before programmable scheduling/memory policy.

fw.description_zh: 负责 KMD 与 GPU system firmware 之间的 transport、versioned ABI、async command/event、capability negotiation、firmware lifecycle、resource ownership、state reconciliation 和 firmware-managed hardware service。它的目标是把散乱 mailbox/doorbell 调用升级成稳定 control plane，使上层 Memory/RAS/Power/Virtualization 不依赖具体 firmware version 或私有消息格式。
fw.description_en: Own transport, versioned ABI, asynchronous commands/events, capability negotiation, firmware lifecycle, resource ownership, state reconciliation, and firmware-managed hardware services between KMD and GPU system firmware. The goal is to turn scattered mailbox/doorbell calls into a stable control plane so Memory/RAS/Power/Virtualization do not depend on specific firmware versions or private message formats.
fw.boundary_zh: Firmware Owner 管机制、协议和 FW lifecycle；RAS 决定 failure containment/recovery policy；Power/Virtualization 等作为 control-plane service 的 client。
fw.boundary_en: Firmware owns mechanisms, protocols, and FW lifecycle; RAS owns failure containment/recovery policy; Power/Virtualization consume control-plane services.

subdirections.title: Versioned Firmware ABI / Command & Event Namespace
subdirections.short_zh: 定义稳定、可版本化的 KMD↔FW contract。
subdirections.short_en: Define a stable, versioned KMD↔FW contract.
subdirections.detail_zh: 覆盖 protocol version、message header、command/event/error namespace、payload version、compatibility rule 与 feature deprecation，避免 feature-local 私有消息不断扩散。
subdirections.detail_en: Cover protocol versions, message headers, command/event/error namespaces, payload versions, compatibility rules, and deprecation.

subdirections.title: Shared-memory / Ring / Mailbox Transport
subdirections.short_zh: 实现 control message 的可靠传输机制。
subdirections.short_en: Implement reliable control-message transport.
subdirections.detail_zh: 负责 shared memory/ring/mailbox/doorbell layout、producer-consumer ordering、wrap、memory barrier、interrupt/coalescing 与 transport reset。
subdirections.detail_en: Own shared-memory/ring/mailbox/doorbell layout, producer-consumer ordering, wrap, barriers, interrupts/coalescing, and transport reset.

subdirections.title: Sequence ID / Async Completion / Timeout / Error
subdirections.short_zh: 把命令处理从同步 helper 提升为完整异步 transaction model。
subdirections.short_en: Turn command handling into a complete asynchronous transaction model.
subdirections.detail_zh: 定义 sequence ID、ACK/completion/event、timeout、cancellation、unsupported/error code、late completion 与 outstanding request teardown。
subdirections.detail_en: Define sequence IDs, ACK/completion/events, timeouts, cancellation, unsupported/error codes, late completions, and teardown of outstanding requests.

subdirections.title: Capability Negotiation / Forward-Backward Compatibility
subdirections.short_zh: 让 KMD 与多版本 FW 安全协商能力。
subdirections.short_en: Let KMD and multiple FW versions negotiate capabilities safely.
subdirections.detail_zh: 负责 HELLO/handshake、capability bitmap/table、required/optional feature、version translation 与 fallback；上层只依赖 stable capability，不散落 fw_version 判断。
subdirections.detail_en: Own HELLO/handshake, capability tables, required/optional features, version translation, and fallback so upper layers depend on stable capabilities instead of fw_version checks.

subdirections.title: Boot / Restart / Upgrade / Rollback Lifecycle
subdirections.short_zh: 管理 firmware 从加载到异常重启的完整生命周期。
subdirections.short_en: Manage firmware lifecycle from load through failure/restart.
subdirections.detail_zh: 覆盖 boot/load/auth、handshake、restart detection、generation、upgrade/rollback、suspend/resume reinit 与 probe failure path。
subdirections.detail_en: Cover boot/load/auth, handshake, restart detection/generations, upgrade/rollback, suspend/resume reinit, and probe-failure paths.

subdirections.title: Resource Ownership / State Reconciliation
subdirections.short_zh: 明确 KMD/FW 对硬件和软件状态的 ownership。
subdirections.short_en: Define KMD/FW ownership of hardware and software state.
subdirections.detail_zh: 为 queue/engine/VM/PM/reset 等资源定义 owner、source of truth、restart 后 state replay/recreate/reconcile 规则，避免双边各自认为自己持有有效状态。
subdirections.detail_en: Define ownership/source-of-truth and restart-time replay/recreate/reconcile rules for queues, engines, VMs, PM, reset, and other resources.

subdirections.title: FW-centric Init / PM / Reset / HW Scheduler Services
subdirections.short_zh: 把 firmware-managed hardware 能力抽象成稳定 service。
subdirections.short_en: Expose firmware-managed hardware capabilities as stable services.
subdirections.detail_zh: 覆盖 init/devinit、clock/PM、reset、engine management、scheduler interface 等服务类，统一复用 async/version/error/lifecycle contract。
subdirections.detail_en: Cover init/devinit, clocks/PM, reset, engine management, and scheduler interfaces using the same async/version/error/lifecycle contract.

subdirections.title: FW Health / Logs / Authentication / Measurement
subdirections.short_zh: 让 firmware 可观测、可诊断并具备可信加载基础。
subdirections.short_en: Make firmware observable, diagnosable, and trustable.
subdirections.detail_zh: 负责 heartbeat/watchdog、log/crash buffer、probe-failure evidence、firmware authenticity/measurement 和 health status，并向 RAS/Security 暴露稳定接口。
subdirections.detail_en: Own heartbeat/watchdog, log/crash buffers, probe-failure evidence, firmware authenticity/measurement, and health status exposed to RAS/Security.
